title: Project Recovery manifest
description: Declares a vault's project roots, the baseline note and labelled lines that answer each recovery field, the decision sources, and the authority policy. Version 0.1 (release R1). recipe.validate_manifest enforces the required keys and the R1 constraints marked below.

name.description: Names the derived index directory under .qmd/.

root.description: Vault root, relative to the manifest file. Source locators in receipts are relative to this root. Overridable with --vault-root.

local_claims.description: R1: every decision is labelled local_only.

verifier.description: R2 placeholder for the serial GitHub verifier.

acceptance_records.description: R2 placeholder: allowlisted repositories and record types.

collection.description: QMD collection name; every query is scoped to it.

root.description: Project directory relative to the vault root (allowlisted source root).

baseline_note.description: Note, relative to the project root, that states the recovery fields.

additionalProperties.description: Line prefixes in the baseline note that answer this field. Each matching line is cited verbatim.

decision_statuses.description: Frontmatter status values that mark a note as a decision source. 'accepted' goes to accepted_decisions (still local_only); others to other_decisions.

record.description: Governing record, relative to the project root.

label.description: A line whose value starts with UNKNOWN yields unknown, with the line cited as evidence.
